change.item: Updated install_extension tool description to prefer source path over base64 content.

addition.item: Added SHA-256 checksum verification for release packages: the release workflow now records the package hash in update.xml so Joomla can validate downloaded updates.

fix.item: Fixed paging issues with broken offset value as well as a wrong total_count.

addition.item: Added pagination metadata (total_count, count, offset, has_more, next_offset) to all list tool responses.
Added a Disabled Tools option to block specific MCP tools by name in component security settings.

change.item: Improved tool execution failures and policy denials handling.

fix.item: Fixed Resolve Host To IP so the override also applies to server local downloads.

addition.item: Added a Resolve Host To IP option: pin the Base URL hostname to a specific IP (e.g. 127.0.0.1) for the component's outbound REST calls only. Lets a server reach its own public hostname when NAT hairpinning is blocked, while keeping the correct Host header and TLS validation intact.
Added a GitHub star banner to the dashboard.

change.item: Updated project branding: added a new logo and refreshed dashboard screenshots, and removed the outdated overview screenshot.
Added more detail for the API token configuration in the README.

addition.item: Added extension installation support: a new install_extension MCP tool installs extensions onto the site.
Added template editing MCP tools: list installed templates, list and read template files, update template files, and create template overrides.

fix.item: Fixed the client configuration snippet generation in the component dashboard view.
Fixed the Monolog log file path resolution.

change.item: Updated the build script to also update the update.xml file.

addition.item: Added request metrics: every MCP request is recorded to a new #__mcpserver_request_log table (method, tool, status, error code, HTTP status, latency, client IP, context).

Added an admin Dashboard view with summary cards (total / last 24h / last 7d / error rate / average latency / rate-limit hits / auth failures), a requests-per-day chart, top tools and methods, and a recent-requests log.
Added Monitoring & Metrics options: toggle recording on/off and configure the retention window (old rows are pruned automatically).

note.item: First stable release published to the Joomla Extensions Directory under GPL-2.0-or-later.

change.item: Aligned the administrator menu and headings with the listing name "MCP Server for Joomla".
Hardened the release build for the official JED Checker.

addition.item: Added template style and installed template MCP tools.
Added article and menu item multilingual association tools.
Added article content history tools for listing, reading, keeping, deleting and restoring versions.
Added Joomla update server metadata for GitHub release packages.

change.item: Prepared the project for Joomla Extensions Directory release under GPL-2.0-or-later.
